title: Póster Vertical de Recuerdos de Viaje con Mapa, Fotos Polaroid y Planificación de Ruta
prompt:
Generate a 2:3 vertical travel memory poster (primarily in Chinese), clean and sophisticated, print-quality clarity and readability.
Location: Paris  Character: Tourist  Time: Tourist
Rules:
1. Map as absolute protagonist: exquisite, information-rich, realistically readable; can connect to the internet to reference Google Maps for data (place names/directions/distances reasonable).
2. Top banner strip (clearly visible): fills the width; text inside the banner must be crisp and sharp, with sufficient contrast, not blurry or faint.
  ◦ Title "Paris · {location in English}"
  ◦ Date using December 2025 (randomly select interval if empty)
  ◦ Background can use location scenery but low contrast and lightly blurred, not affecting text readability.
3. Integration: only at the banner-map junction, create a narrow foggy connection, the map naturally extends; prohibit hard dividing lines/breaks.
4. Three larger Polaroids: classic vertical format (vertical window + thicker white bottom edge, not square); placed at the junction but mainly overlapping on the map; middle one slightly larger; thick white border + light shadow + slight tilt; temperature indicator (-5/+3/+6); handwritten "location subtitle + date". Content strongly related to location.
5. Route: Red pin only once each for 1/2/3; single continuous line 1→2→3; distance in dark rounded capsule floating (not written on the line).
6. Info cards: white rounded card next to each pin, numbers strictly correspond; no overlap, no blocking main route. Contains landmark name + coordinates (monospaced) + thumbnail; thumbnail clear and recognizable but always smaller than Polaroids, lower weight; thin line/arrow pointing to corresponding pin, line end lands on pin.
7. Character (if filled): only appears in Polaroid or thumbnails, no new pins/routes.
Bottom: dark semi-transparent status bar: weather | altitude | coordinates | total distance (neatly aligned).
